about.title: Architecture
paragraphs: I am a Computer Engineering graduate with a strong interest in FPGA development, digital hardware design, and verification.
I have studied in Sweden through international exchange programs, gaining experience in embedded systems, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and reliable digital systems.
My goal is to build a career in hardware design and verification while continuing to improve my technical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

education.description: Focused on computer engineering, digital systems, embedded systems, electronics, computer architecture, networking, and cybersecurity.
Studied reliable embedded systems, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity in an international academic environment.

projects.title: FPGA-Based Cryptographic System
projects.shortDescription: Hardware implementation of AES-128 and SHA-256 algorithms on FPGA to improve cryptographic performance.
projects.problem: Cryptographic algorithms can be computationally expensive when executed only in software.
projects.solution: Designed dedicated hardware modules for AES-128 CTR and SHA-256 using SystemVerilog and implemented them on FPGA platforms.
projects.role: RTL designer, verification developer, and FPGA integrator.
keyResults: Reduced AES-128 processing to 27 clock cycles per block.
Designed and verified SHA-256 padding and processing modules.

projects.title: Mass Bill ERP System
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack ERP system for billing, inventory, and user management.
projects.problem: Businesses need a centralized system to manage billing and inventory efficiently.
projects.solution: Developed a web-based ERP system with role-based access control, invoice generation, and stock tracking.
keyResults: Implemented secure user authentication and RBAC.
Built responsive UI for billing and inventory views.
